_note: Location modifiers and mission variants (Claude's drafts, 2026-09-30, for Logan to vet): rules on top of a run built only from existing statuses and run effects. A location's `modifiers` (sectors.json) are always on there; each location's mission also rolls a variant with the sector (Profile.sector_variants), saved with the run's mission. Numbers are in balance.json conditions; {name} in the text is filled from there.

rain.name: Rain
rain.text: Rain soaks the heat sinks: every mech vents {vent_drop_pct}% less of its heat at max.

jamming.name: Jamming
jamming.text: Signal jamming: every mech's hardpoints start each fight with Jam {stacks}.

dust.name: Dust
dust.text: Mine dust: every mech starts each fight with Smoke {stacks}.

braced.name: Braced
braced.text: Enemies start every fight with Deflect {stacks}.

blackout.name: Blackout
blackout.text: No running lights: every mech starts every fight with Smoke {stacks}.

variants.name: Supply Line
variants.summary: Fights pay {scraps_pct}% more scraps. Elites show up {elite_chance_mult}× as often.

variants.name: Low Visibility
variants.summary: You only see {sight_rows} rows ahead on the map.
